title: Public money approved for candidates, by election
question: How much public financing has the Ethics Commission approved, election by election?
finding: $23,771,782 approved in 546 approvals from 2012 to 2026; the November 2024 election took $8,840,187. The 2014 and 2015 disbursement files agree with the approvals for those years ($194,710 and $307,500). 21 transfer-of-funds forms: 20 move money between a San Francisco candidate's own committees; 1 is a stray filing between federal-style committee numbers (offices 'House' and 'Homeland', June 2025).
how: dbak-p2fq summed by election date; n5sf-qqmx and pnpu-7zb5 compared with it; i7fj-76x7 counted.
limits: Approvals are what the Commission certified, not audits of how the money was spent; the audit reports are not on disk.

sources.t: DataSF dataset dbak-p2fq: Campaign Finance - Public Funds Approved (saved 23 November 2026)
DataSF dataset n5sf-qqmx: Campaign Finance - Public Funds Disbursed - November 4, 2014 Election (saved 23 November 2026)
